clips.title: The story
paras: The Hunt Completed is the culminating moment of Senani Thunderheart's great beast trials in Ashenvale. By felling Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon, a Horde champion proves their strength, tenacity, and primal prowess in a contested forest.

Senani Thunderheart, stationed among the Horde forces in Ashenvale, tests travelers not merely by their loyalty to the warchief, but by their understanding of wild survival. The Ashenvale Hunt targets three legendary predators stalked beneath the ancient boughs: the bear Ursangous, the cat Shadumbra, and the fierce hippogryph Sharptalon. Felling all three and securing their trophies proves a hunter's blood flows true in the challenger's veins.

For the tauren, the hunt is a sacred act of balance and respect, even amidst an active warfront. By overcoming Ashenvale's apex terrors, a hunter honors the spirits of the land and earns the ancestral blessings of Thunderheart. The hunt concludes with a formal commendation and a token of favor, cementing the champion's reputation throughout the forest.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the Ashenvale Hunt. You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity. The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!
Please, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today. May your ancestors watch over you!
